fact: As of 31 March 2024 Eswatini hosted 1904 asylum seekers and 1224 refugees; refugees' PIN and asylum seekers' non-Swazi PIN can be used to obtain a SIM card and mobile money, the IDs are linked to the national population registry, and a CFI survey found 27% of surveyed asylum seekers and refugees financially excluded.
title: Asylum-seekers' and Refugees' Access to the Labour Market in Eswatini
